import pandas as pd
import ast

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/training_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: movie metadata (movieId, title, genres)
# index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column as per Hint 24
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1: user ratings (userId, movieId, rating, timestamp)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source 1 and Source 0 on movieId to get all columns needed for target
df_merged = pd.merge(df_source1, df_source0, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Transformations for target columns:

# genres_arr: convert genres string separated by '|' into a Python list string representation
# e.g. "Crime|Horror|Thriller" -> "['Crime', 'Horror', 'Thriller']"
def genres_to_list_str(genres_str):
    if pd.isna(genres_str) or genres_str == '':
        return "[]"
    genres_list = genres_str.split('|')
    # Return string representation of list with single quotes as in target example
    return str(genres_list)

df_merged['genres_arr'] = df_merged['genres'].apply(genres_to_list_str)

# genre_count: take the first genre from the genres string (before first '|')
# If genres is empty or NaN, set genre_count as empty string
def first_genre(genres_str):
    if pd.isna(genres_str) or genres_str == '':
        return ''
    return genres_str.split('|')[0]

df_merged['genre_count'] = df_merged['genres'].apply(first_genre)

# Ensure data types match target schema:
# Target schema: ['userId': int, 'movieId': int, 'rating': float, 'timestamp': int,
#                 'title': str, 'genres': str, 'genres_arr': str, 'genre_count': str]

df_merged['userId'] = df_merged['userId'].astype(int)
df_merged['movieId'] = df_merged['movieId'].astype(int)
df_merged['rating'] = df_merged['rating'].astype(float)
df_merged['timestamp'] = df_merged['timestamp'].astype(int)
df_merged['title'] = df_merged['title'].astype(str)
df_merged['genres'] = df_merged['genres'].astype(str)
df_merged['genres_arr'] = df_merged['genres_arr'].astype(str)
df_merged['genre_count'] = df_merged['genre_count'].astype(str)

# Select and reorder columns exactly as target schema
df_target = df_merged[['userId', 'movieId', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'title', 'genres', 'genres_arr', 'genre_count']]

# Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
